modifiers.note: Temporal Scaffolding: buildings within 20 of a Manor build 25% faster, stacking per Manor (one Manor modelled). Measured by the owner.

meta.note: Not expressed as modifiers: can Time Shift own buildings (see powers 'time-shift'); lost siege and myth units refund 20% of their cost. Age up: 2 free myth units of the chosen minor god instead of 1.

modifiers.note: Expressed as buildRate x1.25 with condition nearManor (not as buildTime).
